notice: Qualitative study focus, not degree of strength; all four constitutional members remain relevant through Earth human stages. Lemurian stages are overlapping analytical milestones.

origins.name: Physical organization
origins.detail: First germ of physical organization, not the present mineral body.

origins.name: Etheric organization
origins.detail: Life-body joins and transforms the earlier Saturn physical germ.

origins.name: Astral organization
origins.detail: Astral organization joins and further modifies earlier human members.

origins.name: Human I
origins.detail: I is incorporated into an inherited physical, etheric and astral organization.

profiles.interpretation: The human form is described as unusually plastic, shaped by formative will.
profiles.agencies: Higher guides and creative hierarchies (not yet stage-assigned)
profiles.inheritance: Earlier solar-lunar formative forces; pre-existing physical, etheric, astral organization

profiles.interpretation: Moon separation marks a turning point in bodily stabilization.
profiles.agencies: Sun and Moon spiritual powers / higher guiding beings
profiles.inheritance: Plastic human form and evolving etheric/physical structures

profiles.interpretation: Sex differentiation and redirected formative powers prepare later cognition.
profiles.agencies: Higher beings of Love; advanced spiritual guides
profiles.inheritance: Earlier bisexual/undifferentiated reproductive organization; plastically formed bodies

profiles.interpretation: Luciferic involvement changes soul desire and the conditions of individual freedom.
profiles.agencies: Luciferic beings; higher Beings of Love; human guides
profiles.inheritance: Earlier divinely guided soul life and newly differentiated bodies

profiles.interpretation: Will-training and initiatory work highlight formative and soul capacities.
profiles.agencies: Initiates and spiritual world-powers in places of worship
profiles.inheritance: Strong will and immediate perception of growth/natural forces

profiles.interpretation: First durable inner pictures and moral contrasts bring memory and inwardness into focus.
profiles.agencies: Priestesses; higher leaders; guiding spiritual beings
profiles.inheritance: Will culture; sense of forces in nature; songlike expression

profiles.interpretation: Early memory and rhythm are carried toward Atlantis amid the Lemurian catastrophes.
profiles.agencies: Advanced guiding beings and priestesses
profiles.inheritance: Formative will; early memory and imagination; hierarchical guidance

profiles.interpretation: Nature-effective speech and picture-memory become characteristic expressions.
profiles.agencies: Nature-spirits; broader Atlantean hierarchies
profiles.inheritance: Lemurian will, nature-bond, first memory germs

profiles.interpretation: Memory of deeds and personal ambition deepen an emerging sense of self.
profiles.agencies: Luciferic desire continues; guiding powers not mapped stagewise
profiles.inheritance: Rmoahal memory and speech; natural life-force awareness

profiles.interpretation: Political authority and spiritual initiation raise the question of guided agency.
profiles.agencies: King-initiates; Atlantean oracle wisdom
profiles.inheritance: Shared memory; leaders; verbal and life-force power

profiles.interpretation: Life-force manipulation under personal desire becomes a distinctive danger.
profiles.agencies: Luciferic influences persist; Ahriman around middle (epoch-wide)
profiles.inheritance: Life-force mastery, memory-based polities, personal ambition

profiles.interpretation: Comparison, reflective judgment and self-restraint become central.
profiles.agencies: Sun/Christ oracle guidance, Luciferic/Ahrimanic background
profiles.inheritance: Power of memory; spiritual initiation; consequences of life-force misuse

profiles.interpretation: Thought develops practical forms through law, calculation and social organization.
profiles.agencies: Same continuing opposing and guiding currents
profiles.inheritance: Original-Semitic reflective thinking, memory and social organization

profiles.interpretation: Memory and inherited traditions coexist with developing individual thought.
profiles.agencies: Continuing oracle and spiritual currents; stage-specific assignment absent
profiles.inheritance: Thought, memory, ancestral tradition, diminished life-force magic

profiles.interpretation: Spiritual memory accompanies early post-Atlantean cultural formation.
profiles.agencies: Manu; seven Rishis; spiritual teachers; Christ oracle background
profiles.inheritance: Last Atlantean memory, spiritual longings, beginnings of thought

profiles.interpretation: Transformation of earthly conditions becomes a prominent cultural task.
profiles.agencies: Zarathustra; Ahura Mazda/Ormuzd; Ahriman
profiles.inheritance: Ancient Indian spiritual inheritance; growing thought and earthly embodiment

profiles.interpretation: Cosmic order and the interpretation of nature are emphasized.
profiles.agencies: Hermes-linked mystery teachers; hierarchies; inherited opposing influences
profiles.inheritance: Persian earthly engagement, sacred wisdom and cosmic orientation

profiles.interpretation: The Greco-Roman period contains the Mystery of Golgotha and the Christ impulse.
profiles.agencies: Christ; mystery initiates; spiritual hierarchies; persistent Lucifer/Ahriman
profiles.inheritance: Egypto-Chaldean sentient soul and symbolic science

profiles.interpretation: The present consciousness-soul task emphasizes individual thinking and responsibility.
profiles.agencies: Christ impulse; Lucifer and Ahriman; spiritual beings remain active
profiles.inheritance: Greco–Roman personal judgment, Christ impulse and inherited thought

profiles.interpretation: A future cultural development in Steiner's prospective account, not recorded history.
profiles.agencies: Christ / Spirit-Self; ongoing adversarial powers in Steiner’s narrative
profiles.inheritance: Consciousness-soul autonomy and living Christ impulse

profiles.interpretation: A further projected cultural period; exact developments require further source audit.
profiles.agencies: Christ impulse and continuing hierarchies; no exclusive stage catalogue
profiles.inheritance: Sixth period social-spiritual capacities; increasing Spirit-Self orientation
